notes.title: Major Update 12.0 Released
notes.notes:
Update 12 brought some massive physics and quality of life changes that were requested by the community. Especially on tire physics and power curve physics improvements, along with a new class.

 Here is the changelog: 

Added Outlaw Pro Mod 

Added Host Ability to turn off Tow to Burnout

Added Tire Heat Meter 

Increased Size of Tuning Menu Fonts for better readability in Steam Deck and similar devices

Transbrake will now automatically turn off Burnout Mode if you forget to

Further Adjusted Pro Mod Balance

Added More Power to Supercars

Fixed cars steering by themselves when bumping in or deceleration

Improved Tire Dynamics 

Made a change to power management to address power curve inaccuracies 

Adjusted Bike Physics 

Improved Weight Transfer for Pro Stock

Improved Sound for Base Game Supercar

Fixed a DLC supercar not working when selected 

Fixed Wheels offset in one Modified Import 

Changed Pro Stock Mountain motor to use a beefier engine sound 

Added Canopy to top fuel as cosmetic options 

Nitrous Bottle Pressure Maximum was lowered so less purging is required 

Fixed FWD cars interior looking yellow in Garage 

Fixed Game Graphic Settings not loading on Start 

Tires wont smoke when racing down the track 

Made Change in vehicle physics for more realistic wrecks 

Nitro cars now creep forward on idle Nostalgia Nitro is now 2 speed and runs more realistic ETs 

Manual Cars will not show transmission Shifting Window 

Adjusted Powerbands for Pro Mod and RVW for more Low End and Top End Power 

Adjusted Pro Mod Aerodynamics 

Fixed Graphical Glitch with SPE Motorplex

notes.title: Update 6.0 MAJOR Networking Rework
notes.notes:
The latest Update for Bounty Drag Racing is here. The controls system was reworked. If your game does not launch, unplug any controllers or steering wheels, open the game, plug them in and then rebind them. If you have any further issues contact me in the Discord.

Here are the bigger changes of the update:
New Torque Converter Option and Tuning
Remade Timing system from the ground up for better accuracy in times
Qualifying sheet can now pick up Reaction Times for Bracket and Index events
Rebalanced X275 Class
Added X275 Import Class

notes.notes:
The awaited Pro Mod Update is here and it includes 2 new vehicles included in the base game, and 8 DLC vehicles. The update includes new chassis and suspension dynamics that cause cars to slide sideways if too much power is applied. Other fixes include
Increased brake strength for the Top Alcohol Funny Car
Fixed lack of smoke for one of the Extreme Imports
Fixed Smoke of Diesel Engine
Better Handling for the Nitro Bike
Better First Person Camera Effects

An event was held on July 4th to practice with the new Physics.
